Reading · Unit 4
There are many vehicles in town.
Vehicles move people or things.

Where is the car? It is on the highway.
Where is the train? It is on the rails.
Where is the boat? It is on the water.
Where is the bicycle? It is on the bicycle path.
Where is the bus? It is on the street.
Look at the sky! The airplane is in the sky.
1. What do vehicles do?
(A) They make things.
(B) They go down.
(C) They move people.
(D) They help animals.
2. Where is the train?
(A) on the rails
(B) on the bicycle path
(C) on the street
(D) in the sky
3. What is on the water?
(A) the train
(B) the boat
(C) the bus
(D) the airplane
Reading · Unit 5
Boy 1: Look! It’s a duck! See its bill? It has a bill.
Boy 2: No. It’s a rabbit! See its ears? It has two ears.
Boy 1: It’s a duck! See its tail? It has a tail.
Boy 2: It’s a rabbit, silly! See its feet? It has feet.
Boy 1: Of course, it’s a duck! See its wings? It has wings.
Boy 2: No. It’s a rabbit! See its legs? It has legs.
Boy 1: The duck is gone! A rabbit came!
Boy 2: No. The rabbit is gone! This duck scared it off!
1. What does a duck have?
(A) It has a bill.
(B) It has a horn.
(C) It has lips.
(D) It has hands.
2. What does a rabbit have?
(A) a trunk
(B) ears
(C) a bill
(D) wings
3. Why is the rabbit gone?
(A) It sees its ears.
(B) It sees its tail.
(C) The duck is gone.
(D) The duck scared it off.

Reading · Unit 6
Some pictures can do magic. They can trick your eyes.

I see a magician.
Let’s turn it upside down! Poof! Now I see a rabbit!

Look at this picture. I see a monkey. Upside down? Poof! Now I see a duck!

Look at this picture. I see a frog. Upside down? Poof! Now I see a reindeer!

I see an elephant. Upside down? Poof! Now I see an ostrich!

A grumpy man! Now turn it upside down! What do you see?
1. What magic can some pictures do?
(A) They can speak.
(B) They can dance.
(C) They can make animals.
(D) They can trick your eyes.
2. How do you see a duck?
(A) say, "Poof!"
(B) turn the picture upside down
(C) look at the reindeer
(D) find a picture
3. What do you see in the elephant picture?
(A) an ostrich
(B) a rabbit
(C) a reindeer
(D) a monkey
